name: The Box
design_intent: SPORTS calm court #2 (v8_sports_courts.md tier 1, SIZE variety). A SMALL/TIGHT (2000x1200) strict-mirror two-goal pitch: short lanes, close walls -> fast possession swaps, wall-carom bank shots, constant contact. NO hazards, NO powerup_spawners (SYM-6, SC-CALM-CLEAN). SYMMETRY (SC-SYM, the CD #7 fix): every element is a vertical-axis mirror about centre x=1000 -- both mid bumpers sit at the SAME y=520 so gravity treats both halves identically. FLIGHT GATE (GAME_ESSENCE Rule A): centre x=1000; nearest inner spawn x=1440/560 -> 440px to centre (> 395 trampoline drift); centre-to-far-goal 1000->240 = 760px (> 527 spring drift), so reaching the ball and pressing it to the far goal REQUIRE boost. Full-width TRAMPOLINE floor (y1000) + bumper ceiling/walls -> no flat standable ground (Pillar 2). Goal mouth y470..730 each end (centre y=600); goal_zone just inside, back wall seals the pocket.
